script.cite: BK1 printed p.11 = book1.pdf PDF p.13
script.quote: The light does not come on because there is not a closed circuit.

script.cite: BK1 printed p.11 = book1.pdf PDF p.13
script.quote: Push down pushbutton 1. Light 1 comes ON.

script.cite: BK1 printed p.11 = book1.pdf PDF p.13
script.quote: Release pushbutton 1 and push down pushbutton 2. The light again comes ON.

script.cite: BK1 printed p.11 = book1.pdf PDF p.13
script.quote: The circuit is closed and the light comes ON if either pushbutton 1 is down OR if pushbutton 2 is down OR if both pushbutton 1 and pushbutton 2 are down at the same time.
